description: This file defines the RedirectMiddleware class, which handles HTTP redirect logic as middleware within the GuzzleHttp library. It manages redirect following, history tracking, and related request modifications.

classes.name: RedirectMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for handling HTTP redirects within GuzzleHttp. Manages redirect rules, limits, request modifications, and history tracking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that injects the next handler callable in the middleware chain.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles the request, applies redirect logic if configured, and returns a promise of a response.

methods.name: checkRedirect
methods.description: Evaluates the response for redirect status, manages redirect count, and prepares the next request if needed.

methods.name: withTracking
methods.description: Enables redirect history tracking by modifying response headers in the promise chain.

methods.name: guardMax
methods.description: Checks if the maximum number of redirects has been exceeded and throws an exception if so.

methods.name: modifyRequest
methods.description: Modifies the outgoing request based on redirect response, including method, URI, headers, and other options.
